newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Perstorp to reshuffle group from Feb 1.
newsitem.headline: Perstorp to reshuffle group from Feb 1.

text.p: Swedish chemical company Perstorp AB said on Tuesday it was reorganising the group from February 1 with three competitive divisions.
The new, larger business divisions would be chemicals, surfaces and plastic systems.

"We are now creating three competitive divisions in order to help us derive increased value from group synergies and benefits of scale," Perstorp president and chief executive officer Ake Fredriksson said in a statement.
The Pernovo unit would continue to be reponsible for business development on the periphery of the group's core businesses.
